breakdown.description: An axisymmetric simulation requires the front and back planes of the mesh wedge to be of type 'wedge', but they are specified as 'empty', which is used for 2D planar simulations.
breakdown.reason: The user's request incorrectly specified the front and back planes of the wedge as 'empty'. The generated specification correctly changed this, stating: "Set the wedge planes to type wedge..." This is the correct boundary condition type for an axisymmetric simulation in OpenFOAM.
